subject: general
question: By selling an article for ₹19.50, a dealer makes a profit of 30%. By how much should be increase his selling price so as to make a profit of 40%?
solution:
**Given:**

Selling Price (SP) = ₹19.50

Profit Percentage (P₁) = 30%

New Profit Percentage (P₂) = 40%

**Formula used:**

Cost Price (CP) = dfrac{SP}{1 + dfrac{P1}{100}}

New Selling Price (SPₙₑw) = CP × (1 + (dfrac{P2}{100})

**Calculation:**

CP = dfrac{19.50}{1 + dfrac{30}{100}}

⇒ CP = dfrac{19.50}{1.30}

⇒ CP = ₹15

SPₙₑw = 15 × (1 + dfrac{40}{100})

⇒ SPₙₑw = 15 × 1.40

⇒ SPₙₑw = ₹21

Increase in Selling Price = SPₙₑw - SP

⇒ Increase in Selling Price = 21 - 19.50

⇒ Increase in Selling Price = ₹1.50

**∴ The correct answer is option 4.**
